item.title: Self-Hosted TV Broadcast Playout Automation: CasparCG vs Sofie vs OpenBroadcaster
item.description: Television broadcast playout — the process of scheduling and outputting video content to air — was once the exclusive domain of six-figure hardware systems from vendors like Grass Valley and Harmonic. Today, open-source software has transformed broadcast engineering, bringing professional-grade playout automation within reach of community TV stations, live event producers, and in-house corporate studios.
